purpose: startRun with no cost_consent: since BETA-COST-PREFLIGHT-1030 a new paid start requires a fresh confirmed consent, so this is 422 validation_failed (cost_consent / confirmation_required) and nothing is created
pre_authorization: Captured after the T-6 seam landed. Every request here presents the configured bearer credential and is answered. No record here exercises a caller's rights, so none pins 401 or 403.

body.text: {"contract_version": "{{contract_version}}", "error_code": "validation_failed", "message": "The request or payload violates a declared schema, enum, format or invariant. Nothing was created or changed.", "correlation_id": "{{correlation_id}}", "retryable": false, "details": {"field": "cost_consent", "constraint": "confirmation_required"}}

tokens.{{content_length}}: a function of the body, which is compared byte for byte; the comparison asserts Content-Length == str(len(body)) separately
tokens.{{contract_version}}: the version the frozen contract declares for every ErrorEnvelope (ErrorEnvelope.contract_version.const of contracts/api/v1/openapi.json, equal to its info.version), read from the contract and not from the response; a body naming any other version keeps its literal and does not match
tokens.{{correlation_id}}: assigned by the edge because the request carried none; checked against the pinned CorrelationId shape before being tokenised
tokens.{{session_tag}}: this capture run's tag, carried by every idempotency key
